metadata.question: On July 20, 2025 at 10:44 am local time, was there a volcanic eruption in Halema‘uma‘u Crater, the summit caldera of Hawaii’s Kīlauea volcano?

data.raw_code: The user asks about a volcanic eruption at Halema'uma'u Crater on July 20, 2025 at 10:44 am local time. This is a very specific event detection question. Key considerations: 1. **Data Choice**: Need to detect thermal anomalies or volcanic activity. Best options: - VIIRS/NPP thermal anomalies (375m resolution, daily) - MODIS thermal anomalies (1km resolution, daily) - Sentinel-2 MSI (visual detection, 10m resolution, but may miss thermal signals) - Landsat 8/9 TIRS (thermal bands, 100m resolution) 2. **Time Window**: July 20, 2025 at 10:44 am local time (Hawaii-Aleutian Standard Time, UTC-10). Need to convert to UTC: - Local time: 10:44 AM HAST (UTC-10) = 20:44 UTC same day - We should check satellite overpass times around this window (±1 hour) 3. **Location**: Halema'uma'u Crater at Kīlauea, Hawaii (approx 19.406°N, 155.283°W) 4. **Approach**: - Use VIIRS/NPP thermal anomaly product (VNP14A1) which detects hotspots including volcanoes - Check for fire/thermal anomaly pixels in the crater area on that specific date/time - Use confidence levels (high confidence = likely volcanic activity) 5. **Fallback strategy**: - If VIIRS has no data, try MODIS (MOD14A1/MYD14A1) - If no thermal data, try Sentinel-2 or Landsat for visual confirmation - If all fail, output appropriate C codes 6. **Validation**: - Check pixel counts of thermal anomalies - Use confidence band to filter reliable detections - Consider diurnal cycle (morning detection may be weaker) Let's structure the code to: 1. Define the crater location and time window 2. Try VIIRS thermal anomaly product first 3. If no data, try MODIS 4. Count high-confidence thermal anomaly pixels 5. Output evidence and final answer ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const crater = ee.Geometry.Point([-155.283, 19.406]); // Halema'uma'u Crater const buffer = crater.buffer(1000); // 1km buffer around crater // July 20, 2025 at 10:44 am local time (HAST = UTC-10) = 20:44 UTC const targetDate = '2025-07-20'; const startTime = ee.Date('2025-07-20T19:44:00'); // UTC: 1 hour before local time const endTime = ee.Date('2025-07-20T21:44:00'); // UTC: 1 hour after local time // 2. Data Acquisition - Try VIIRS thermal anomalies first let viirsCol = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14A1') .filterBounds(buffer) .filterDate(startTime, endTime); let viirsSize = viirsCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`VIIRS Images: ${viirsSize}`); let result = null; let collectionName = ''; if (viirsSize > 0) { // Use VIIRS data collectionName = 'VIIRS'; const viirsImg = viirsCol.first(); // Band info: 'MaxFRP' = Fire Radiative Power, 'Confidence' = detection confidence // Confidence values: 0-3 (low), 4-6 (nominal), 7-9 (high) const highConfidence = viirsImg.select('Confidence').gte(7); // High confidence mask // Count high-confidence thermal anomaly pixels in buffer const stats = highConfidence.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: buffer, scale: 375, // VIIRS resolution maxPixels: 1e9 }); const highConfCount = stats.get('Confidence').getInfo(); console.log(`High-confidence thermal pixels: ${highConfCount}`); // Also check total FRP for magnitude const frpStats = viirsImg.select('MaxFRP').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: buffer, scale: 375, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const meanFRP = frpStats.get('MaxFRP').getInfo(); console.log(`Mean Fire Radiative Power: ${meanFRP ? meanFRP.toFixed(2) : 'null'}`); result = highConfCount; } else { // Try MODIS as fallback console.log('No VIIRS data, trying MODIS...'); // Check both Terra (MOD14A1) and Aqua (MYD14A1) const modisTerra = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD14A1') .filterBounds(buffer) .filterDate(startTime, endTime); const modisAqua = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD14A1') .filterBounds(buffer) .filterDate(startTime, endTime); const terraSize = modisTerra.size().getInfo(); const aquaSize = modisAqua.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS Terra: ${terraSize}, Aqua: ${aquaSize}`); let modisCol = modisTerra.merge(modisAqua); const totalModis = terraSize + aquaSize; if (totalModis > 0) { collectionName = 'MODIS'; const modisImg = modisCol.mosaic(); // Combine available overpasses // MODIS fire mask: values 7,8,9 = fire (high confidence) const fireMask = modisImg.select('FireMask').gte(7); const stats = fireMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, // MODIS resolution maxPixels: 1e9 }); const fireCount = stats.get('FireMask').getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS fire pixels: ${fireCount}`); result = fireCount; } } // 3. Validation & Final Answer if (result === null) { // No data in any collection console.log('No thermal anomaly data available for specified time/location.'); console.log('C1'); } else if (result === undefined || isNaN(result)) { // Calculation failed console.log('Calculation failed - invalid result.'); console.log('C3'); } else if (result === 0) { // Valid zero - no thermal anomalies detected console.log(`No thermal anomalies detected in ${collectionName} data.`); console.log('B'); } else if (result > 0) { // Thermal anomalies detected console.log(`Detected ${result} thermal anomaly pixel(s) in ${collectionName} data.`); console.log('A'); } else { // Unexpected case console.log('C3'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
